name: Eternity gives Clasp of Infinity its 15% damage-taken effect (#938)
contract: Clasp of Infinity 805847's tooltip reads "$?s805844[While rooted, targets take $s2% increased damage.][]". In Spell.dbc, Clasp's Effect[1] is SPELL_AURA_MOD_DAMAGE_FROM_CASTER (271) with EffectMiscValue 127 (all schools), EffectBasePoints -1 and DieSides 1, so it resolves to 0 on its own. Eternity 805844's Effect[0] is SPELL_AURA_ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER (107) with EffectMiscValue 12 (SPELLMOD_EFFECT2), EffectBasePoints 14 and DieSides 1 (+15), EffectSpellClassMask [8388608,0,0], which inside SpellFamilyName 28 selects 805847 and nothing else. SpellEffectInfo::CalcValue calls Unit::ApplyEffectModifiers, which routes SPELLMOD_EFFECT2 to effect index 1 (Unit.cpp), so the aura's amount becomes 15; Unit::SpellDamageBonusTaken and Unit::MeleeDamageBonusTaken consume aura 271 filtered by the aura caster's GUID, which is the tooltip's "damage dealt to the target by you". Generic core machinery, no Chronomancer-specific code. This scenario is a regression guard for behaviour that already works.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Clasp's damage-taken effect before the talent
Without Eternity the effect resolves to zero
Clasp's damage-taken effect resolves to 15 with Eternity
Eternity adds exactly 15 to that effect
